throughput.notes:
Data-dependent. Min/max measured over a range of divisors with 8 independent lanes.

Min CPI 4.499 at divisor=0x80000000; max CPI 12.5 at divisor=0x1; dividend=0xffffffff.

notes: Latency: 100 outer iterations x 100 divisions; each block is <op>; and; add.d, and the measured cycles/division include the 2-cycle and+add chain, so 2 is subtracted. Throughput: 8 independent lanes with the same dividend/divisor pair.
